pairs.ch: 我聽到她痛苦地尖叫，馬上請醫療人員前來幫忙。
pairs.en: I heard her scream in pain and immediately asked the medical staff for help.

pairs.ch: 我們注意到 Tim 把所有時間都投入於訓練，因為他一心一意想成為冠軍。
pairs.en: We noticed Tim dedicating all his time to training since he had his heart set on becoming a champion.

pairs.ch: 儘管失敗過很多次，我們團隊最終成功說服這位客戶。
pairs.en: In spite of many failures, our team finally succeeded in convincing the client.

pairs.ch: 儘管人手不足，這間醫院仍提供了立即的協助。
pairs.en: Despite the lack of staff, the hospital still provided immediate support.

pairs.ch: 儘管我妹妹面臨這些挑戰，她仍努力完成她的科學專題。(My sister...despite....)
pairs.en: My sister struggled to finish her science project despite the challenges she faced.

pairs.ch: 有個實驗室的研究人員正在研究不同的調味料。(There is....)
pairs.en: There is a lab where researchers are doing studying different flavorings.

pairs.ch: 我們家喜歡那間餐廳，那裡所有的食材都來自有機農場。
pairs.en: Our family likes the restaurant where all the ingredients come from organic farms.

pairs.ch: 我永遠不會忘記那一天，當時我想出了解決那個問題的辦法。
pairs.en: I'll never forget the day when I came up with a solution to the problem.

pairs.ch: 這次的廣播通知不像上次那樣明確，所以許多乘客感到困惑。
pairs.en: The announcement wasn't as clear as the previous one, so many passengers felt confused.

pairs.ch: 這款智慧型手機沒有前一代(the previous generation)那麼多功能，但用起來更簡單。
pairs.en: This smartphone doesn't have as many functions as the previous generation, but it's easier to use.

pairs.ch: 我早就把打翻的牛奶清乾淨了，但媽媽仍勃然大怒。
pairs.en: I had already cleaned up the spilled milk, but my Mom still flew into a rage.

pairs.ch: Cindy 早已描述過那名嫌疑犯的外貌，所以警方很快就認出他。
pairs.en: Cindy had already described the suspect's appearance, so the police recognized him quickly.

pairs.ch: 我在想他是否能夠專注在自己的科學研究上。
pairs.en: I was wondering if he could concentrate on his scientific research.

pairs.ch: 我一直想知道 Peter 是否真的是那麼固執。
pairs.en: I've always wondered if Peter is really that stubborn.

pairs.ch: 我不清楚 Lucy 是否還懊悔之前說的那些話。
pairs.en: I don't know if Lucy still regretted what she had said.

pairs.ch: Nick 在說服校長採納這項政策時遇到很大的困難。(trouble)
pairs.en: Nick had (great/much/a lot of) trouble persuading the principal to adopt the policy.

pairs.ch: 許多人在面對壓力時要控制自己的情緒有困難。
pairs.en: Many people have problems controlling their emotions when they are (facing stress/under pressure).

pairs.ch: 受到政府官員威脅的那名記者(journalist)決定公開發聲支持新聞自由(freedom of the press)。(N + V-ing/p.p.)
pairs.en: The journalist threatened by government officials decided to speak out for freedom of the press.

pairs.ch: 醫生認為 Susan 要從那場意外造成的傷害中康復會有困難。(difficulty; N + V-ing/p.p.)
pairs.en: The doctor thinks that Susan will have difficulty recovering from the injury caused by the accident.

pairs.ch: 一些人權團體呼籲政府廢除(abolish)禁止女性接受教育的政策。(N + V-ing/p.p.)
pairs.en: Some human rights groups called for the government to abolish the policy forbidding women from receiving education.

pairs.ch: Frank 唯一想做的就是實現他成為一位知名藝術家的夢想。(All....)
pairs.en: All [that] Frank wants to do is (fulfill/achieve/realize) his dream of becoming a famous artist.

pairs.ch: Julia 用豐富的想像力編輯故事，這位他帶來成功的寫作事業。(..., which....)
pairs.en: Julia wove stories with her rich imagination, which brougth her a successful writing career.

pairs.ch: 政府需要做的就是努力克服貧窮所造成的障礙。(What....)
pairs.en: What the government needs to do is try hard overcome the obstacle (which/that are) caused by poverty.

pairs.ch: 那個女孩在遊行中要求人們為地球立即行動，這使她成為網路上的熱門話題(trending topic)。(..., which....)
pairs.en: The girl requested people to spring into action for the earth durig the parade, which made a trending topic online.

pairs.ch: 那個網紅(influencer)試圖做的是持續傳達正確的資訊，這位他贏得了娛樂圈的尊重。(What....; ..., which....)
pairs.en: What the influencer (tries/tried) to do (is/was) convey correct information consistently, which [has] earned him respect in the enterteinment industry.

pairs.ch: 典禮即將來臨，大家既緊張又興奮。(With + O + OC....)
pairs.en: With the ceremony approaching, everyone felt [both] nervous and excited.

pairs.ch: 人們正在他身邊小聲說話，Mark 覺得很難專注。(With + O + OC....)
pairs.en: With people whispering around him, Mark found it hard to concentrate.

pairs.ch: David 慢慢走回家，心中充滿對那個事件的擔憂。(..., with + O + OC....)
pairs.en: David walked home slowly, with his mind full of worries about the incident.

pairs.ch: 這個班上有些孩子持續霸凌同學，有些則裝作沒看到，而剩下其他人則嘗試保護被霸凌者。
pairs.en: Some kids in the class kept bullying their classmates, (some/others) pretended not to see it, and the others tried to (protect/defend) the bullied.

pairs.ch: 三個人被困在建築物裡。一個受了重傷，另一個被嚇到並哭泣，還有一個試圖保持冷靜並呼救。
pairs.en: Three people were trapped in the building. One was (badly/seriously) injured, another was scared and crying, and the other treid to stay calm and called for help.
